label: Three omission scopes of giving, by derivation and finite controls
description: A placed diagnostic for 0050b6ed. It certifies the §56 omission table that was hand-checked only: individual omission, whole-actual-roster withholding with replacement, and total refraining are distinct and strictly ordered modal profiles of a source's giving; a necessarily productive source (necessarily operative purpose, categorically directed generative nature, or a maximizer for whom a creation beats omission) can satisfy the first two but not the third, and a necessary manifestation satisfies none. The replacement frame satisfies #1897's ActualAbsenceByWithholding while giving something at every world. Finite surrogates only; no intellect, goodness or simplicity is typed.
